title: POV: you drew the 10 of Clubs (my pixel-art card roguelite, Aita: The Dark Domain)
author: Tommyruin
selftext:
Hey folks, Aita dev here! I've been working on my game for 10 months now and am in the process of advertising it.   
  
In Aita, your hand is your attack and your defence at once, which makes going all in a trap. Free solo demo on Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4730130/?utm\_source=reddit&utm\_campaign=steam\_demo\_launch\_2026&utm\_content=short\_all\_in](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4730130/?utm_source=reddit&utm_campaign=steam_demo_launch_2026&utm_content=short_all_in)

Please check it out and give it a wishlist!

Music: "The Gauntlet and the Dragon" by Eclipzodiac

comments.author: Tommyruin
comments.body: If you want to try this out on the web, you can check it out here: [https://aitatdd.com/play](https://aitatdd.com/play) :)

comments.author: Imaginary_Pizza8805
comments.body: Are you aware that in Reddit AITA stands for "Am I the asshole?"?

replies.author: Tommyruin
replies.body:
Haha yes I am, he's also the god of the underworld in Etruscan mythology (of which this game is based!) There are some funny memes related to it: 

https://preview.redd.it/31kt5x6cr8uh1.png?width=2360&format=png&auto=webp&s=8ee421e7119334e1618c22b5f666974a4d1c812a

comments.author: gholias
comments.body:
Dude, loved the game!  
The images are pretty awesome and the gameplay is interesting and fresh.  
I had some problems understanding the gameplay with the tutorial, but after playing a game, it made more sense.  
  
Not sure what to suggest to fix the tutorial. I had issues understanding when using multiple cards and what each card does.

This has great potential. Keep it up

replies.author: Tommyruin
replies.body: Thank you so much for trying it out! The tutorial has been a real sticking point for me, and I will keep working on it. The rules themselves are simple but can take time to understand, so its hard to convey that in the tutorial. I'll keep thinking on that. Cheers again
